title: Punt City 2: Game 1 - The Most Competitive CEDH Event in History by Eminence Gaming!
description:
The most competitive CEDH tournament in History has finally arrived! Punt City 2 by Eminence Gaming took place from 3/25-3/26 and was packed with incredible talent from all around the nation. 60 and 100-card players alike were all coming down to Pheonixville, PA for one reason alone: to win the most competitive CEDH tournament of all time! 

Join your hosts Scoots and Ashani for Game 1 of this amazing event featuring: 

Jack on Tymna/Kraum
Jordan on Tymna/Kraum
Spencer on Tevesh/Kraum
Bryant Cook on Rog/Si
